comment: Seventeen outputs are configured but the widget adds only twelve, so outputs 12 to 16 have no jack on the panel and can never be clicked or patched. The eight single bit jacks carry bits 8 to 15 of the sequencer's register, taken from TuringGateExpander.cpp:67 where the message float is cast to a byte whose bit 7 is the register's top bit; the jack at the top of the column is bit 8, the lowest of the eight, and the bottom of the column is the register's top bit. The four combination jacks use the byte's bits 1, 2, 4 and 7. The panel carries no lettering on any jack.
